description: NaAs₄O₆Br crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaAs₄O₆Br sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to eight O and one Br atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.80 Å. The Na-Br bond length is 3.25 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.85 Å) As-O bond lengths. In the second As site, As is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.82 Å) and two longer (1.86 Å) As-O bond lengths. In the third As site, As is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.85 Å) and one longer (1.87 Å) As-O bond length. In the fourth As site, As is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.81 Å) and two longer (1.84 Å) As-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two As atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two As atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂As₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. Br is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na atom.
